p.text: What does the new teacher look like?

1.say: Sarah, we have a new teacher at school. Really? What does he look like? He is tall and thin. He has short dark hair. Does he wear glasses? Yes, and he has a small black beard. And what is he like? He is very kind and patient. But he is quiet. Quiet is good. Our old teacher was not quiet! The students like him. He is not lazy — he is hard-working. He looks like a good teacher.

grammar.label: adjective position
grammar.form: adjective + noun; be + adjective; adjectives never take -s

explanation.en: Adjectives go before the noun or after be. They never take -s.
explanation.uz: Sifat otdan OLDIN yoki 'be' dan KEYIN keladi. Sifatga hech qachon -s qo'shilmaydi.

grammar.negative_example: They are talls boys. / They are boys tall.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada ham sifat otdan oldin keladi — bu oson. Faqat sifat ko'plik olmasligini eslang.

grammar.label: adjective order — first set
grammar.meaning: the fixed order of multiple adjectives

explanation.en: When you use more than one adjective, the order is: opinion, size, colour. A nice big red car.

l1_notes.uz: Bu tartibni ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar sezib turadi — mashq bilan avtomatlashadi.
